category_edits.rationale: Apply temperature-1.1 pairwise smoothing across all four datasets, preserving the gradient at tied scores while sustaining pressure on correctly ordered pairs. Retain the 0.2 pointwise coefficient and uniform valid-position averaging. Architecture, inference, sampling and training settings remain unchanged.

response.change_summary: Change only the pairwise loss to 1.1*softplus((s_neg-s_pos)/1.1). Predictor and checkpoint formats require no changes.
